failure_clusters.does_not_prove: Does not prove that a break-even stop will always improve net R, as some trades might hit the break-even stop and then go on to hit the original profit target.
evidence: Gross loss of 60.23 R across 40 trades.
Average MFE is 1.26 R, but win rate is only 32.03%, showing that many trades go highly favorable before reversing into losses.

failure_clusters.does_not_prove: Does not prove that tightening the stop-loss to 0.75R will improve performance, as it might stop out trades that would have otherwise recovered to win.
evidence: Gross loss of 131.85 R across 86 trades.
Almost all losses (86 out of 87) experience a deep adverse excursion of <= -0.75R.
